items.title: A morphism of algebraic spaces is unramified exactly when its diagonal is an open immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, unramifiedness of f is equivalent to the diagonal Delta_{X/Y} : X -> X x_Y X being an open immersion, the second direction under the extra assumption that f is locally of finite type (source lines 7724-7734). The proof works with the cartesian square built from surjective etale V -> Y and U -> X x_Y V: it first records that the diagonal is always a representable monomorphism and that the middle vertical arrow is etale, then in one direction uses the scheme case for U -> V together with locality of etaleness on the source to make Delta_{X/Y} a representable etale monomorphism and hence an open immersion, and in the other direction uses that the diagonal of a morphism of schemes is an immersion to upgrade etaleness of Delta_{U/V} to an open immersion and conclude unramifiedness of U -> V and then of f.
